summary: Iter27 — Public-facing /investors executive summary tested end-to-end. All 4 public endpoints work without auth, both PDFs render >150KB with content-type application/pdf + inline disposition, investor-intro form persists to db.investor_intros, honeypot silently drops bot submissions (no DB entry), brand-aware swap to FedEx works and restored to Orisei. Frontend /investors, /press, /exec-summary all render the page with PublicNav, hero, 99% probability badge, all download CTAs (target=_blank rel=noopener), TAM/SAM/SOM cards, trajectory cards, ASK + use-of-funds, intro form with green-check thank-you state, footer. OG + Twitter Card meta tags injected dynamically on page load. Fixed one backend bug (Pydantic v2 + FastAPI didn't detect closure-scoped InvestorIntro as a body model — moved to module scope).

issues: Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be > 0' fires twice on initial mount before the chart container has its layout. Cosmetic only — the area chart renders correctly after layout settles. Could be silenced by giving the container a defined min-height.

AuthProvider fires /api/auth/me on every public page load and the response is 401 (expected for anonymous), generating ~6 console errors per route change. Page works fine, but the noise pollutes the console for visiting VCs who open DevTools. Consider short-circuiting auth fetches when the route is in the public-route allowlist.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts width/height warning by ensuring the ResponsiveContainer parent has a deterministic height before mount.
(Optional) Skip /api/auth/me fetch on public routes (/home, /services, /lanes, /contact, /investors, /press, /exec-summary, /about) to keep the DevTools console clean for visiting investors.

FastAPI's body-detection failed and treated `payload` as a query param → all POSTs returned 422. Moved to module scope alongside QuoteRequestIn/ContactIn. The Open Graph image URL hard-codes /brand/orisei_wordmark.png even when the active brand is FedEx — when the brand-swap goes live publicly, og:image should be derived from brand.logo_url to keep social previews consistent.

rca of the issue: Symptom: POST /api/public/investor-intro returned 422 with detail [{'type':'missing','loc':['query','payload'],'msg':'Field required'}]. Root cause: the InvestorIntro Pydantic model was declared inside the build_public_router(api_router, db) function as a closure-local class. FastAPI's parameter-resolution scans the function signature at registration time; with Pydantic v2, the detection path that recognizes BaseModel subclasses as body models depends on the model being importable / having a stable __module__. The closure-scoped class confused this detection, so FastAPI fell back to treating the typed parameter as a query parameter, and the absence of a `payload` query string yielded a 422. Fix: hoisted InvestorIntro to module scope (alongside the already-correct QuoteRequestIn and ContactIn). Reproduction: revert that one block and rerun the test suite — all three TestPublicInvestorIntro cases will flip back to 422. Mitigation/standard: keep all Pydantic request/response models at module top-level, never inside router-builder closures.
